enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Tendon Slice +4: On Hit: 6% chance to slow target's movement by 50% for 4 seconds.
Electrifying 2: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to arc with electricity, dealing 2d6 Lightning damage on each hit.
Freezing 6: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 6 to 36 Ice damage on each critical hit.
Armor-Piercing 8%: Passive: +8% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
